name: vue-i18n-python-tooling
description: Development tooling only. The library is Python; nothing here is published or shipped.
//: This package exists for two jobs, both of which are development-time and neither of which is
1. VitePress, which builds the documentation site under docs/.
2. The conformance generators under scripts/conformance/, which run REAL vue-i18n and record
what it returns. Those recordings are what the Python port is held to. Without them the
port could only claim to match vue-i18n; with them it is checked against it on every run.
`private: true` so it can never be published by accident.
